name: ZIP Extractor
description: Open a .zip file in your browser, browse its contents, and extract individual files or everything without installing anything.
body:
📦

Drop a .zip file here or click to browse

Opened locally with JSZip — nothing is uploaded

Archive contents

Drop a ZIP file to see its contents.
howto: Drop your .zip file onto the dropzone.
The archive is opened in your browser and its contents are listed.
Tick the files you want, or leave all selected.
Click Extract all as ZIP to re-bundle the chosen files, or Download selected to grab the ticked ones directly.
Files with a check appear as a list with sizes for easy review.
features: Browse ZIP contents without installing anything
Select individual files or extract everything

faq.a: No. The ZIP is opened entirely in your browser with JSZip. Your files never leave your device.

faq.q: Can I extract just one file?
faq.a: Yes. Tick the files you want and click Download selected to save only those.
Encrypted ZIPs are not supported by the browser-side JSZip build used here. Standard (unencrypted) archives work perfectly.
Large archives work, but extraction is limited by your device's memory. Very big archives may take a moment to list.
